title: PAR-134 DBCOLOR CMC flags and reserved-index retention
mode: generated AC1024 DWG object-vector fast slice
scope: Retain R2004+ DBCOLOR CMC flags and reserved index alongside normalized color data
Preserve supported C0-C3 optional color/book names, including flagged-empty strings
Reject malformed provenance and unavailable detached strings before output
Keep unsupported DBCOLOR methods and independent producer semantics unqualified

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: The generic R2004+ CMC wire representation has a leading BS reserved as zero, a packed BL method/value, and an RC byte whose low bits introduce optional color-name and color-book TV strings. The reviewed ODA copy does not specify DBCOLOR's custom-class CMC field semantics beyond this generic representation.

localSource.finding: DRW_DbColor retained normalized method/index/RGB and optional names but dropped the CMC raw flags/index. Its writer used the RGB-only convenience overload, which omitted optional names for ByLayer, ByBlock, and ACI methods; unsupported C4-C8 reader refusal remains unchanged.

productionSummary: Append DBCOLOR CMC raw flags, reserved index, and metadata-presence fields; reset and DXF group updates clear the DWG provenance.
Capture flags/index through the bounded CMC reader while keeping normalized colorIndex separate from the reserved BS index.
Write method-aware C0-C3 CMC values with names/books for every supported method; replay source flags and preserve flagged-empty fields.
Preflight reserved index, known flag bits, string/flag consistency, RGB/method data, and detached R2007+ strings before output.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: Appended fields increase DRW_DbColor object size; downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.dwgVectors: Generated AC1024 DBCOLOR frames cover named ByBlock, named RGB, book-only ACI, and ByLayer with a flagged-empty optional name.
generatedControls.wireWalk: Independent cursor checks the emitted CMC reserved index, scalar/RGB projection, method, flags, and optional names before production parsing.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Production parser assertions cover source metadata, copy, assignment, reset, and normalized color method/index.
generatedControls.failClosed: Controls refuse nonzero reserved index, unknown flags, unflagged color/book strings, flagged-empty strings without detached storage, and the existing unsupported methods before publication/output.

validation.strictBuild: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_wave1_tests libdxfrw_hardening_tests libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4

evidenceLimits: Generated vectors establish local reader/writer consistency, not independent DBCOLOR producer semantics.
Unsupported C4-C8 methods retain the existing fail-closed parse/write behavior; this slice does not define their payload semantics.
No persistent fixture, external producer/reader, native CAD application, full suite, or platform qualification was run.
No DXF mapping or support claim was changed.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
